name: Bile Lash
description: The occultist's idle strike: a flick of humour at whatever you're facing.

name: Gall Spark
description: A spit of yellow bile, set alight. Pushes your bile towards the hot pole.

name: Black Draught
description: Draw black bile out of the wound and into yourself, healing a little of what you deal.

name: Still the Humours
description: A steadying cut that pulls your bile back towards balance, whichever way it has run.

name: Bitter Salt
description: Choleric salts thrown hot. They only catch if your bile already runs yellow.

name: Choleric Flare
description: Let the heat out all at once. Needs a choleric temper.

name: Melancholy Shroud
description: Wrap yourself in black bile: a cold strike, then 30% less damage taken for six seconds.

name: Vitriol Rain
description: The old war-craft of the fen houses, in miniature. Needs your bile at +60 or hotter.

name: Black Sun
description: Melancholy made total. Strikes, restores a fifth of your blood, and wards you. Needs bile at -60 or colder.
